attributes.name: card text alignment
attributes.definition: Horizontal alignment of text inside cards or content blocks.

values.definition: Text inside cards is explicitly left-aligned.
Alignment is not stated or is mixed.

attributes.name: card surface colour
attributes.definition: Background treatment of cards or content blocks.

values.definition: Cards have a white or near-white fill.
Cards use an image background darkened by a gradient overlay.
Any other card fill or none.

attributes.name: card edge accent
attributes.definition: Border or rule treatment that marks the edges of cards.

values.definition: A thick coloured stripe or border on the left edge of the card.

values.value: full thin border with rounded corners
values.definition: A thin border all around the card with rounded corners.
A thin border all around the card with square corners.
A rule along the top edge of the card.
No border accent, or a different treatment.

attributes.name: text colour tone pairing
attributes.definition: How heading and body text colours differ within cards.

values.definition: Headings and body copy use clearly different tones, such as bright headings and muted body.
Headings use an accent colour or bold distinct colour.
Heading and body share the same colour, or this is not stated.

attributes.name: card heading decoration
attributes.definition: Decoration or typographic treatment applied to card headings.

values.definition: Serif heading with an accent-coloured underline.
An icon is placed next to the heading.
Bold heading or name in a strong colour.
No special decoration or not stated.
